mobbin:4359c189-557b-424c-af85-3b1a7b574.summary: From the empty Products landing the user starts Add new product, fills name/barcode/brand/measure/descriptions/photo/category, scrolls into Pricing and Inventory (SKU), saves, and lands on Product list with a created toast.
steal: Empty state sells catalog + ops: Start now, import many at once, and low stock reminders in one pitch (step 1).
Soft barcode validation that warns without blocking save (steps 3–9).
Measure dropdown paired with Amount (ml 100) for volume consumables (steps 4–5).
Enable retail sales toggle that can hide sell/commission chrome when the item is stock-only (step 10).
avoid: Team member commission + markup/tax stack on create (steps 10–11) — salon POS fields, not sim equipment.
mobbin:4359c189-557b-424c-af85-3b1a7b574.fit: Extends basic items with barcode + unit/amount useful for consumables and later scan check-out; clash if we ship full retail pricing on create. Catalog vs Inventory (Stocktakes / Stock orders / Suppliers) split is a useful IA hint.
